text:
Type: wire mesh basket with wooden handle
Use: storing fruit, magazines, throws or small things; kitchen, living room, home office
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, modern
Materials: white powder-coated steel mesh, solid band at the rim, bent birch plywood handle
Colors: white, light natural wood
Shape: square open basket with a fine diamond mesh, wide flat rim, arched wooden carry handle on metal pivots, light and airy
Feel: fresh, practical, airy, tidy
Goes with: light wood, white shelves, green plants, linen; Scandinavian, farmhouse or modern rooms

product.name: RISATORP
product.description: This basket makes it easy to access and get an overview of your fruit and vegetables, and is decorative to display.
